reits.name: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No numeric DPU guidance. Manager (12 Aug 2026): Gallileo lease commencement, the Paragon acquisition (completed 1 Jul 2026, S$3.9B agreed value) and continued positive rental reversions, together with lower financing costs, "provide greater income visibility and support a strong growth outlook". Asia Square Tower 2 divestment (~S$2.45B net proceeds, 3.0% exit yield) completed 17 Sep 2026. Tampines Mall AEI completing 3Q 2026; Lot One AEI 1Q 2027; Plaza Singapura/Atrium AEI 4Q 2028. 3Q 2026 business update not yet released as at 26 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CICT has NO perpetual/hybrid securities outstanding: the 1H 2026 slide deck ICR footnote states "CICT did not issue any hybrid securities". gearing_pct_incl_perps left null (no-perps convention); economically equal to headline 37.4%.

reits.name: CapitaLand Ascendas REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No numeric DPU guidance. Manager expects FY2026 average rental reversions to remain positive in the high single-digit range; two more Singapore acquisitions in 2H 2026 (both completed Aug 2026); ~S$0.6B acquisitions announced for 2H 2026; proposed divestment of Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex at a 32% premium to valuation. S$900M equity fund raising in 1H 2026 lowered gearing to 39.7% (from 42.0% at 31 Mar 2026). ~9.6% of GRI due for renewal in rest of FY2026. 3Q 2026 business update not yet released as at 26 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CLAR has S$302.3M of (green) perpetual securities holders' funds as at 30 Jun 2026 (S$302.4M at 31 Dec 2025) per 1H 2026 financial statements; the slide deck references S$300M Green Perpetual Securities. (v3 note mentioning an additional S$300M Series 002 issue is not supported by the balance sheet and has been dropped.) Headline aggregate leverage 39.7% excludes perpetuals. Incl. perps = (total debt S$8,275M + S$302.3M) / total assets S$20,851M = 41.1%.

reits.name: CapitaLand Ascott Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Managers "remain committed to delivering stable distributions", supported by operating performance and distribution of non-periodic and/or divestment gains where appropriate; core distribution income impacted by transitional factors (acquisition/divestment timing, AEIs, FX, one-off tax). Somerset Clarke Quay Singapore expected to contribute from early 2027. No numeric guidance. 3Q 2026 business update not yet released as at 26 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CLAS has S$407.2M of perpetual securities holders' funds as at 30 Jun 2026 (unchanged from 31 Dec 2025). Headline gearing 37.7% excludes perpetuals. Total assets S$8,819.4M; aggregate-leverage debt approx 37.7% x 8,819.4 = S$3,325M; incl. perps (3,325 + 407.2) / 8,819.4 = 42.3%.

reits.name: CapitaLand China Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Strategy: expand retail in Tier 1/2 cities, maintain stable business/logistics park occupancy, recycle mature assets, evaluate AEIs/acquisitions, expand RMB debt access. RMB600m FTZ bond due Oct 2026 refinanced at ~2.3%.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. 1H 2026 DPU 2.45 S cents; TTM 4.78 S cents includes a 0.33-cent top-up that may not recur.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CLCT has S$149.8m perpetual securities (S$150M issued 19 Sep 2025; S$100M redeemed 27 Oct 2025), treated as equity in headline gearing. Computed incl. perps as debt: (41.1% x S$4,297.8m deposited property = ~S$1,766m borrowings + S$149.8m) / S$4,297.8m = 44.6% as at 30 Sep 2026. NOTE: prior revision's 42.0% understated the add-back (perps are ~3.5% of deposited property).
reits.wale_basis: Portfolio WALE 2.0 years by Gross Rental Income; 2.4 years by NLA (30 Sep 2026). Retail 2.1 GRI/3.4 NLA, Business Park 1.7/1.8, Logistics 2.5/2.5.
reits.aum_total: S$4.3 billion (property value); total assets S$4.6 billion
reits.report_period: 3Q 2026 (Business Updates, 9M to 30 September 2026); DPU/NAV from 1H 2026 results

reits.name: CapitaLand India Trust
reits.sub_sector: IT Business Parks / Logistics / Data Centres (Business Trust)
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Distribution policy 90% of income available for distribution. Onshore INR term loan drawn Jul 2026 (INR5.5bn) expected to give 1.6% DPU accretion on FY2025 DPU basis; full income from DC Navi Mumbai T1 from Aug 2026; forward-purchase pipeline (aVance 5 and aVance A1 Hyderabad completed). INR/SGD translation remains the key swing factor.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. Manager cites +1.6% DPU accretion (vs FY2025 DPU 7.87c) from the Jul 2026 onshore INR loan; INR depreciation continues to erode SGD DPU.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CLINT has S$101.4m perpetual securities (balance sheet 30 Jun 2026; S$100m issued FY2025), treated as equity in the 38.0% gearing. Computed incl. perps: (S$1,695m effective borrowings + S$101.4m) / implied Trust property value (~S$4,461m = 1,695/0.38) = 40.3%. ICR 2.9x already includes perp distributions (3.0x excl.).
reits.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry 3.2 years; Weighted Average Lease Term 6.4 years (by base rent; excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres)

reits.name: Mapletree Logistics Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Outlook (28 Jul 2026): global economy expected to moderate amid high energy prices and inflation; leasing demand resilient; continued currency volatility and elevated borrowing costs expected to remain headwinds. Focus: occupancy, rental stability, cost efficiency; ~S$1bn of properties identified for divestment (about half China/HK), S$155M divestments announced post-1Q (39 Changi South Ave 2 completed 5 Oct 2026; an Australian property completed 23 Oct 2026). No numeric guidance. 2Q FY26/27 results due after market on 28 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: MLT perpetual securities holders' funds S$580.7M at 30 Jun 2026 (S$582.4M at 31 Mar 2026) per the 1Q FY26/27 SGX financial statement. CORRECTION: v3 counted only S$180M; the balance also includes a S$400M perpetual (ISIN SGXF7755013), which MLT is refinancing with the S$400M 3.50% Series 015 perpetuals priced 4 Aug 2026. Headline aggregate leverage 40.5% excludes perpetuals; incl. perps = 40.5% + 580.7 / total assets 13,763 = 44.7%. Manager discloses total debt (incl. perps) to NAV of 86.2%.

reits.name: Mapletree Industrial Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager (23 Jul 2026): confirmed non-renewal of leases within the North American Portfolio in FY26/27 and higher borrowing cost from repricing of maturing interest rate swaps expected to affect near-term performance; targeted North America divestments of S$500-600M; continued leasing focus in NA. No numeric guidance. 2Q FY26/27 results due after market on 27 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Series 002 S$300M 3.15% perps redeemed 11 May 2026; remaining S$300M Series 006 3.25% perps (issued 4 Mar 2026) carried at S$299.6M at 30 Jun 2026. Headline aggregate leverage 37.5% excludes perps. Incl. perps = (total borrowings incl. JV share S$3,084.8M + S$299.6M) / implied deposited property (3,084.8 / 0.375 = S$8,226M) = 41.1%.

reits.name: Mapletree Pan Asia Commercial Trust
reits.geography: Singapore / Hong Kong / China / Japan / South Korea
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Outlook (30 Jul 2026): geopolitical tension, trade frictions and Middle East-driven energy prices weigh on confidence (overseas markets under greater pressure) and keep the rate outlook uncertain; debt reduction and lower financing costs expected to cushion overseas headwinds this year; VivoCity outperformance continues. No numeric guidance. Moody's Baa2 with NEGATIVE outlook. 2Q FY26/27 results due before market open on 30 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: MPACT REDEEMED its S$250M 3.50% perpetual securities in 1Q FY26/27 (refinanced with S$200M 2.53% notes due 2033); perpetual securities holders' funds are nil at 30 Jun 2026 (S$249.1M at 31 Mar 2026). gearing_pct_incl_perps therefore left null (no-perps convention); economically equal to headline 37.7% (the rise from 36.5% reflects the perps being replaced by debt).

reits.name: Keppel REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No numeric DPU guidance. Post-period: KR Ginza II divested (JPY11.52B, completed Aug 2026); T Tower Seoul to be divested at KRW348.8B (7.4% above valuation, 4Q 2026), with up to S$25M of proceeds for unit buybacks after the 3Q update; 20 Oct 2026 proposed acquisition of 51% of Keppel South Central from sponsor Keppel at S$626.2M (4.3% initial yield, +2.01% pro forma DPU accretion, supported by a guaranteed S$2.23M/month income arrangement for up to 5 years as the building was ~60% committed at 15 Oct 2026; IPT requiring EGM in 4Q 2026). 3Q 2026 business update scheduled 28 Oct 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Keppel REIT perpetual securities S$402.7M at 30 Jun 2026 (S$300M 3.78% issued 11 Aug 2025 + S$100M 3.28% issued 27 Nov 2025), classified as equity and excluded from 40.0% headline. Incl. perps = (borrowings incl. JV share S$4,830M + S$402.7M) / deposited properties S$12,068M = 43.4%. The proposed Keppel South Central acquisition may be partly funded with new perpetual securities.

reits.name: Keppel DC REIT
reits.geography: Singapore / Japan / Australia / China / Malaysia / Germany / Ireland / Italy / Netherlands
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No numeric DPU guidance. 3Q 2026 update (23 Oct 2026): 9M 2026 DPU +11.7% YoY; Tokyo DC 4 & 5 acquisition (+2.0% DPU accretion, in-place rents >30% under-rented) completed 1 Oct 2026, partly funded by ~S$625M private placement (~3.4x covered); Gore Hill DC revenue to more than double when new contracts start end-2026; KDC SGP 8 AEI 2H 2027. Watch items: Guangdong DCs master tenant rent uncollected with loss allowances recognised; Cardiff DC vacant since Jun 2026 contract expiry; macro: Middle East energy prices, rates may rise further.

reits.wale_basis: GRI (by rental income; 6.5y by lettable area); incl. Tokyo DC 4 & 5: 4.8y by rental income, 6.6y by lettable area
reits.report_period: 3Q 2026 operational update (9 months ended 30 Sep 2026); NAV/balance-sheet items from 1H 2026 results (30 Jun 2026)

reits.name: KORE US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Distribution quantum for 2H 2026 (1 Jul - 31 Dec 2026) expected to remain consistent with 1H 2026 (0.40 US cents), subject to market/financing conditions and interest rates; Manager anticipates progressively increasing payout ratio (1H 2026 ~21%) towards a sustainable level. Targets FY2026 year-end occupancy broadly in line with end-2025 (87.2%). Evaluating selective divestments with proceeds possibly applied to debt reduction.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: 2H 2026 DPU expected to remain consistent with 1H 2026 DPU of 0.40 US cents (manager guidance on distribution quantum, subject to prevailing market and financing conditions and interest rate movements). Implied FY2026 DPU ~0.80 US cents if guidance holds. Value is the guided next half-year DPU, not a full-year figure.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: KORE US REIT has no perpetual securities outstanding (1H 2026 balance sheet: Unitholders' Funds US$729.739M, no perpetual capital line); perp-inclusive gearing = headline 43.3%.
reits.wale_basis: by CRI (cash rental income) as at 30 Jun 2026; by NLA = 4.0 years per Top-10 tenant slide (note: lease-expiry slide footnote states 3.8 years by NLA - internal inconsistency in the deck)

reits.perpetual_securities_note: PLife REIT has no perpetual securities outstanding (deck lists perpetual bonds only as a possible future funding source). Gearing inclusive of perpetuals equals headline gearing.

reits.name: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Board reaffirmed FY2026 DPS expected to be broadly in line with FY2025 (13.39 euro cents), barring unforeseen circumstances. Proposed internalisation of managers/platform (announced 28 Sep 2026, subject to EGM and approvals) expected to increase pro forma FY2025 DPS by 5.9%; SWI Group to subscribe 40m new securities at €2.00. Target 80+% logistics/light industrial/data centre exposure by 2028.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: Board guidance (reaffirmed 13 Aug 2026): FY2026 DPS broadly in line with FY2025 DPS of 13.39 euro cents per stapled security. 1H 2026 delivered 6.642 (+1.4% YoY). Excludes any uplift from the proposed internalisation (pro forma +5.9% on FY2025 basis, subject to approvals).
reits.perpetual_securities_note: CORRECTION vs prior revision: SERT DOES have perpetual securities - 'Net assets attributable to Perpetual securities holders' €64.2m at the Stoneweg European REIT level (30 Jun 2026; €64.2m at 31 Dec 2025), distributions payable semi-annually, non-cumulative (FS note 19). Perp-inclusive gearing computed: manager net debt (€1,047m - €45m cash ~= €1,001.7m) + €64.2m perps = €1,065.9m over the implied denominator of the 41.9% net gearing (~€2,391m) = 44.6%. Approximate (EMTN definition denominators not fully disclosed).
reits.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry 4.9 years as at 30 Jun 2026; WALB 4.0 years

reits.name: OUE REIT

Total debt S$2,484M / 0.421 = implied deposited property S$5,900M; (2,484 + 212.3) / 5,900 = 45.7%. Manager may issue up to S$150M perpetual securities to fund the 180 George Street acquisition.

reits.name: BHG Retail REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No explicit DPU guidance; manager focused on tenant curation, experiential/community offerings and prudent capital management. NPI fell 6.0% y-o-y in 1H 2026 (lower occupancy; rental support to Dalian and Xining). ICR 1.7x below 1.8x threshold
reits.perpetual_securities_note: No perpetual securities outstanding (1H 2026 financial statements: "adjusted ICR is the same as ICR")
reits.wale_basis: by gross rental income as at 30 June 2026; 4.0 years by committed NLA
reits.aum_total: SGD 892.813 million (investment properties as at 30 Jun 2026; RMB 4,694.0m valuation at 31 Dec 2025, SGD value up on RMB strength)

reits.name: IREIT Global
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Finance costs expected to increase due to refinancing exercises and additional borrowings for Berlin Campus repositioning; manager evaluating strategic and funding options to manage impact on capital structure and distributions. Spanish Portfolio refinancing (extension to Dec 2029) expected to be finalised 2H 2026. Berlin Campus Phase 1 completion expected 3Q 2027; BVG 25-year lease signed Sep 2026.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast; manager flags further increases in finance costs (refinancing, Berlin Campus borrowings) as a headwind. 1H 2026 DPU 0.37 euro cents.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: IREIT Global has no perpetual securities (30 Jun 2026: gross borrowings €401.7m of bank loans and S$85m green notes; net assets €423.3m attributable to unitholders). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 45.5%.
reits.wale_basis: Based on gross rental income as at 30 Jun 2026 (excluding Berlin Campus)

reits.name: Elite UK REIT
reits.sponsor: Ho Lee Group / Elite Partners Holdings
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: FY2026 DPU expected to rise steadily, underpinned by recent acquisitions and progressive execution of asset repositioning (barring material adverse developments). Net gearing likely to trend towards 35-40% target. Remaining DWP regears for 2028 expiries in progress; Lindsay House PBSA conversion to open Sep 2027.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No numeric forecast. Guidance upgraded from 'broadly in line with FY2025' (3.03 pence) to 'FY2026 DPU expected to rise steadily'; 1H 2026 DPU 1.555 pence. A number cannot be derived without guessing.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Elite UK REIT has no perpetual securities (30 Jun 2026: total debt £162.4m of term loans and RCF; net assets £279.6m attributable to unitholders). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 34.8%.
reits.wale_basis: WALE 7.1 years as at 30 Jun 2026 on a pro forma basis (incl. divestment of four Welsh assets in Jul 2026 and acquisition of five government-leased properties in Aug 2026); basis not further specified.

reits.name: Manulife US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Distributions remain suspended. Minimum Sale Target (US$328.7m) under the MRA exceeded after the Figueroa sale; manager targets exiting the MRA by end-2026 (subject to lender negotiations) and then to 'initiate distributions at a sustainable payout ratio'. No quantitative DPU guidance. Growth and Value Up Plan (approved 16 Dec 2025) allows acquisitions of US/Canadian industrial, living and retail assets.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: Distributions SUSPENDED; lenders require suspension until the later of meeting Reinstatement Conditions and the Bank ICR relaxation period (to 31 Dec 2026). No DPU forecast; 0 reflects the affirmatively-disclosed suspension. Resumption only after MRA exit (targeted end-2026, subject to lenders).
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Manulife US REIT has NO perpetual securities outstanding (1H 2026 balance sheet shows only unitholders' funds; borrowings consist of trust-level term loans and the US$137.0m Sponsor-Lender loan). Perp-inclusive gearing therefore equals headline 54.1%; field left null as there are no perps to add back.
reits.wale_basis: Portfolio WALE as at 30 Jun 2026 (basis not specified on summary slide; property-level WALE given by NLA). Top-10 tenants WALE 4.8 yrs by NLA / 4.6 yrs by GRI.

reits.name: Prime US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager expects to maintain payout ratio at no less than 65% going forward; ~492k sf of committed leases (11.7% of committed occupancy) to commence rent on a staggered basis mostly from 3Q 2026, expected to lift cash property income. Refinancing: US$550m credit facilities and US$66.95m loan extended to 15/19 Dec 2026 while a longer-term financing is completed (20 Oct 2026).
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No numeric DPU forecast. Manager guides payout ratio of no less than 65% and rising cash income as ~492k sf of signed leases commence from 3Q 2026; 2H 2026 outcome also depends on refinancing terms of the facilities now maturing Dec 2026.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Prime US REIT has no perpetual securities (1H 2026 balance sheet: borrowings are bank loans only; net assets US$755.2M all attributable to unitholders). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 44.9%.
reits.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry computed for all committed leases (from later of commencement date or 30 Jun 2026)

reits.name: United Hampshire US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Manager focused on leasing, disciplined capital recycling (BJ's Quincy sold Sep 2026 at 4.9% above valuation) and prudent growth; no refinancing requirement until February 2028; weighted average interest rate declining.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. 1H 2026 DPU 2.16 US cents (+3.4% YoY); TTM 4.46 US cents.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: UHREIT has no perpetual securities (1H 2026 balance sheet: loans and borrowings US$327.2M; net assets attributable to unitholders only). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 40.4%. Note 'Perpetual (Asia) Limited' is the trustee, not a perpetual security.
reits.wale_basis: Based on gross rental income of Grocery & Necessity Properties for the month of June 2026

reits.name: Acrophyte Hospitality Trust
reits.sub_sector: US Hotels (was ARA US Hospitality Trust)
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Distributions SUSPENDED effective 1H 2026, expected to remain until 2H 2028 (may resume earlier). Rationale: ~US$100m capex FY2025-27 (US$26.6m FY2026, US$45.0m FY2027) vs US$26.0m cash; gearing ~43% near 50% limit; US$198.5m secured term loan due Sep 2026 under extension/amendment negotiations. Equity fund raising kept as contingency. Strategic review ongoing: managers "remain in discussions with the Sponsor on a potential transaction relating to the Stapled Securities" (23 Oct 2026)
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: Distributions suspended effective 1H 2026 and expected to remain suspended until 2H 2028 (press release 6 Aug 2026); no distributions forecast for FY2026-FY2027
reits.perpetual_securities_note: No perpetual securities outstanding (bank borrowings only; total debt US$324.5m: secured US$249.5m + unsecured US$75.0m)
reits.wale_basis: Not applicable in the traditional sense (hotel REIT with day-to-day room revenues; no fixed-tenor leases)
reits.aum_total: USD 705.5 million (carrying value of hotel properties at 30 Jun 2026, based on internal valuations; US$714.9m at 31 Dec 2025). Independent Newmark valuations at 30 Jun 2026 for the 26 Hyatt hotels total US$550.7m
reits.report_period: 1H 2026 (6 months ended 30 June 2026); 3Q 2026 business update scheduled 4 Nov 2026
